B: one clean left-aligned column with sensible hierarchy (wordmark → headline → subhead → pills → CTA). But everything is crammed into the top-left two-thirds, which leaves a large empty bottom and right side with only a lone pink circle. It reads as under-adapted, though it is cleaner than A.
